title: Brown Butter Blondies
changes_from_base: All the butter is browned first for a toffee-like, nutty flavour; no add-ins.
summary: Small-batch blondies made with browned butter, brown sugar and vanilla.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with a baking-paper sling

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan); paper-line a 20 cm square tin.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Melt the butter in a small pan over medium heat and keep cooking, stirring, until it foams, smells nutty and the specks turn brown. Pour into a bowl, scraping in the browned bits, and cool 10 min.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Whisk the brown sugar into the butter, then the egg and vanilla. Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt until smooth.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread in the tin and bake 20-25 min, until the edges are golden and the middle is just set.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely in the tin before cutting into 16 small squares.

tips: Use a light-coloured pan so you can see the butter browning.
Scrape in all the brown bits; they hold the flavour.
Cool the butter so it does not scramble the egg.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
